nodes.label: WAT Framework (Workflows, Agents, Tools)
nodes.rationale: Separates probabilistic AI reasoning from deterministic code execution; compounding per-step error (90%^5 = 59%) makes offloading execution to scripts more reliable.

nodes.label: Self-Improvement Loop
nodes.rationale: Every failure: identify, fix tool, verify, update workflow, so the system hardens over time.

nodes.rationale: Simple/Mengundang 6 months, Meriah 1 year; extension costs extra

nodes.rationale: Unique single-use QR per guest prevents duplication; scan in 2-3 seconds; replaces manual guestbook and typos

nodes.label: Live Greeting Display

nodes.label: Check-in Manual

nodes.rationale: Real-time attendance stats, refresh every 10 seconds

nodes.rationale: Check-in data stored on device and auto-synced when internet returns so event continues if WiFi fails

nodes.label: Hybrid Product Model
nodes.rationale: Curated templates; user fills data, picks color/font variant, toggles sections - volume of templates matters more than editor sophistication.

nodes.label: Shared Core Data Schema
nodes.rationale: All templates share one data schema so users can switch template without re-entering data; Sekar proved it required zero _core changes.

nodes.label: Sekar Template (Jawa keraton)
nodes.rationale: Built from the contract only with zero _core changes to prove the template spec; library-light (no animation lib).

nodes.label: Raudhah Template (Islami minimalis, photoless-first)
nodes.rationale: Market priority #3 from S2 theme catalog; Marcellus digits look like letters so numbers use Lora.

nodes.label: W.ui Core Shared Widgets
nodes.rationale: ~150 lines of RSVP/wishes/gift/video JS duplicated between Eloise and Sekar moved into core.js when template #3 arrived; templates keep markup/CSS with fixed ids.

nodes.label: window.INVITE Render Contract
nodes.rationale: Single global {data, theme, sections, guest, runtime, labels, presets, registry, template} plus HTML markers replaces planned WEDDING/THEME/SECTIONS globals.

nodes.label: tools/render_template.py
nodes.rationale: Reference implementation for the S7 Next.js render route.

nodes.label: tools/screenshot_page.mjs (CDP screenshot/console check)
nodes.rationale: Headless chrome --screenshot cannot capture scrolled pages and has ~500px min width.

nodes.label: tools/build_template.mjs (production build)
nodes.rationale: Obfuscator hoists string-array helpers to program scope so output is wrapped after obfuscation; controlFlowFlattening/deadCodeInjection off for cheap phones.

nodes.label: Library Licensing Replacement (lightGallery GPL, Exmouth -> GLightbox, Pinyon Script)
nodes.rationale: lightGallery (GPLv3) and Exmouth (commercial font) blocked selling; replaced with MIT/OFL alternatives, jQuery/Slick/Font Awesome removed.
nodes.norm_label: library licensing replacement (lightgallery gpl, exmouth -> glightbox, pinyon script)

nodes.label: DIY-plus Positioning Rp79-249rb (Hemat/Lengkap/Premium)
nodes.rationale: Below Rp50rb is a saturated price war; above Rp400rb buyers expect human service. Final price decided by user in S8.

nodes.label: Active Period + Cheap Extension + Auto Archive

nodes.label: Realistic MVP Differentiators
nodes.rationale: Quick buy, self-serve Excel->link+WA, per-guest open tracking, template switch without re-entry, asset protection - features competitors lack or only offer via manual service.

nodes.label: Text Presets Depend on Religion/Adat, Not Template
nodes.rationale: religion and ceremony belong in core data; templates only display them.
nodes.norm_label: text presets depend on religion/adat, not template

nodes.label: Photoless Mode
nodes.rationale: Required for Islami and privacy-minded couples; gallery/couple photos replaced by illustration or initials.

nodes.label: schema.ts (Zod InvitationData)
nodes.rationale: One schema for all templates so switching templates never needs data re-entry

nodes.label: W.ui shared widgets
nodes.rationale: Interactive sections implemented once in core.js; templates only own markup (fixed ids) and CSS

nodes.label: Section visibility rule
nodes.rationale: Off sections are removed from DOM; visible when in manifest AND on AND requires met AND not photoless-hidden

nodes.label: HTML binding attributes (data-t/data-l/data-if/data-href)
nodes.rationale: No literal copy in template HTML; validator fails on text nodes

nodes.label: Content != copy rule
nodes.rationale: Data holds names/dates/venues; titles and salam come from labels + religion presets, user overrides via data.copy

nodes.label: Raudhah template (Islami, photoless-first, minimal starter)
nodes.rationale: Smallest template; start new templates from this one

nodes.label: --c-* CSS color tokens
nodes.rationale: Colors only as tokens so variants recolor consistently; alpha via rgb(var(--c-x-rgb) / .5)

nodes.label: Color variants
nodes.rationale: 3-4 variants each defining every --c-* token

nodes.label: Visual QA matrix
nodes.rationale: Fixture x variant x guest/photoless coverage; screenshot tool must exit 0

nodes.label: javascript-obfuscator build
nodes.rationale: Wrap after obfuscation to avoid leaking _0x globals; renameGlobals/transformObjectKeys off because window.INVITE/W.V are the contract; controlFlowFlattening off for cheap Android phones

nodes.label: Headless rAF stall quirk
nodes.rationale: GSAP timelines stall in headless Chrome, so always test with ?open=1

nodes.label: Mask-based single-tone patterns
nodes.rationale: Batik tiles via mask + var(--c-accent) recolor through tokens without generated SVG sets

nodes.label: RSVP submit smoke test
nodes.rationale: Any W.ui change affects every template

nodes.label: Google Fonts (OFL) only
nodes.rationale: Licensing: no commercial fonts unless bought and logged
